newsitem.title: GERMANY: TNT appoints new Germany president.
newsitem.headline: TNT appoints new Germany president.

text.p: Three more senior German managers of TNT are leaving the German unit following the takeover of the global express company by Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV.
In addition to German chief executive Frank Blochmann, sales and marketing director Raimund Stuer, operations director Wolfgang Albeck and corporate accounts manager Werner Nies are leaving.
Wagner has been named the new president of TNT Holding GmbH and is responsible for all TNT operations and subsidiaries in Germany with effect from Friday, spokesman Marcus Wohler told Reuters.

Wohler said it was not yet clear when the other managers would leave the company but TNT expected to announce the future plans of Frank Blochmann very shortly. TNT said earlier that the remaining management positions would be filled internally.
Wagner is responsible for all TNT operations in Germany, including GD Express Worldwide, the integrator's international air cargo arm.

But the management changes do not affect GD Express Worldwide in Germany, Wohler said stressing that the TNT Germany operations were very successful and one of the most important parts of the TNT group. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
